lines.en: In a desperate attempt to avoid leaving empty-handed, I reach out and grab the first DVD I see on the way out of the shop.
lines.zh: 为了不空手而归，我孤注一掷，在出门的路上随手抓起第一张映入眼帘的 DVD。

lines.en: : Hey! You can't just-
lines.zh: : 喂！您不能就这么——

lines.en: : Ugh, never mind! Just take it! I’ll pay for it myself!
lines.zh: : 呃，算了！您拿走吧！我自己掏钱付！

lines.en: I give up resisting once I have something in my hands and Makoto is eventually able to push me outside, quickly locking the door behind me.
lines.zh: 手里有了东西，我就不再反抗了，Makoto 总算把我推出了门外，随即迅速锁上了门。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei! You were never here and neither was I!
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei！您从没来过这儿，我也从没在这儿出现过！

lines.en: : Goodnight, Makoto. See you tomorrow night.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Makoto。明晚见。

lines.en: : I sure hope not!
lines.zh: : 我希望不会！

lines.en: Left alone with nothing but my new DVD and the night sky, I glance down to inspect the cover.
lines.zh: 只剩下我的新 DVD 和夜空作伴，我低头端详起封面来。

lines.en: : “After School Service: Student Council Punishment Games”
lines.zh: : 《放学后的服务：学生会惩罚游戏》

lines.en: : I can work with this.
lines.zh: : 这个我凑合能用。
